newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares end up on Q1 reports, Ericsson.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares end up on Q1 reports, Ericsson.

text.p: 1500 GMT - Swedish shares ended higher on Thursday, boosted by first quarter earnings reports, a strong performance by telecoms group Ericsson and a stronger U.S. market. * Stockholm general index rose 1.16 percent to 2,639.09 * Turnover 4.96 billion crowns * Ericsson rose 8.5 crowns to 252.5 ahead of releasing its first quarter report on Friday and a stronger IBM in New York. * Truck maker Scania, forestry group Stora and steel maker SSAB all benefited from releasing first quarter figures. Scania rose 3.5 crowns to 192, Stora jumped 4.5 to 106.5 and SSAB leaped 10 to 142.
